adapters.privacyBoundary: Only caller-approved CSV/JSON fixture paths and sanitized metadata enter build records.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: No watcher exists; freshness comes from explicit caller-provided files.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: No remote rate limit; local checks cap file size and source count.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Build records capture inspected file metadata, rejection reasons, and generated draft paths.

adapters.privacyBoundary: Only mapping decisions and sanitized field names are prompt-visible.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Freshness is inherited from the source manifest being confirmed.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: No remote rate limit; confirmation is a caller-supervised local action.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Handoff records capture whether mappings are proposed, confirmed, or rejected.

adapters.privacyBoundary: No uploaded bytes or private rows enter artifacts because upload intake is not implemented.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Upload recency must be declared by a future runtime; current checks cannot verify it.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: Future upload intake must declare size and rate limits before execution.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Future runtime must record approval, upload reference, hash, timestamp, and sanitized errors.

adapters.privacyBoundary: Fixture replay exposes normalized public fixture metadata, not private live connector payloads.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Normal checks use committed fixtures; live freshness is only an explicit opt-in readiness probe.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: Normal checks make no network calls, so external connector rate limits are not exercised.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Connector result records capture fixture status, unavailable evidence, and sanitized diagnostics.

adapters.privacyBoundary: No private API credentials, request payloads, or response rows enter generated artifacts.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Future adapters must declare request time, cache policy, and source freshness before forecasting.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: Future adapters must declare rate limits and retries before any call is allowed.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Future runtime must record approval, endpoint identity, scopes, timestamps, and sanitized errors.

adapters.privacyBoundary: No database credentials, query text with secrets, or private rows enter generated artifacts.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Future adapters must declare query timestamp, isolation, and freshness policy before forecasting.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: Future adapters must declare query limits, timeout, and retry policy before execution.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Future runtime must record approval, dataset identity, query boundary, timestamps, and sanitized errors.

guards.name: declaration_only
guards.rule: Capability records describe adapter boundaries and must not execute source reads by implication.

guards.name: workflow_source_binding
guards.rule: Adapter source kinds must match the domain-agnostic private setup workflow source kinds.

guards.name: no_secret_storage
guards.rule: Adapters must not store credentials or expose secrets in generated artifacts.

guards.name: normal_checks_offline
guards.rule: Normal checks may inspect fixtures but must not fetch live private API or database data.

guards.name: planned_private_runtimes
guards.rule: Private API, private database, and manual upload adapters remain non-executable until a runtime lands.

guards.name: freshness_and_audit_boundary
guards.rule: Freshness, rate-limit, privacy, and audit boundaries must be declared before setup attempts.

warnings: This is a capability declaration, not a connector runtime.
Private API, private database, and manual upload adapters cannot execute in the current local surface.
No adapter may store credentials or include secrets in forecast artifacts.
Normal checks remain offline and fixture-safe.
